content_sections.heading: About MGU
content_sections.text: Mahatma Gandhi University is located at Priyadarsini Hills P.O., Kottayam, Kerala - 686 560, and was established by the Kerala State Legislature by Notification No. 3431/Leg. Cl/85/Law, dated 17th April 1985. The Course Mentor post is in the Online BBA Honours Programme run by the university's Centre for Distance and Online Education (CDOE). This is Re-Notification-2, issued on 18 November 2026 with reference to Notification No. 98849/ADA7-1/2025/ADA7 dated 12.01.2026 and Renotification-1 dated 16.02.2026.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application goes by email only, to [email protected] , within 15 days from the date of the notification (18 November 2026). Fill in the proforma attached with the notification (pages 3 to 5 of the PDF: "Proforma-Application for the post of Course Mentor (Online BBA Honours) - on contract at CDOE"). Prepare scanned copies of the original documents listed under Enclosures below. Send the filled proforma and the scanned copies to [email protected] . Use exactly this subject head: "Application for the post of Course Mentor (Online BBA Honours) - on contract - CDOE" . The proforma asks for the candidate's name, address, age and date of birth, mobile number, email ID, religion and caste, and the institution, university, year of passing and percentage of marks for SSLC, UG and PG. It also asks for the subject of specialisation in post graduation, NET details and Ph.D. details (year, university, faculty), and ends with a signed declaration that the candidate possesses all original documents to prove the claims made. The proforma also records these details, with numbers: Teaching Aptitude: teaching experience (in guest/contract/temporary positions, service is counted only after acquiring the minimum qualification stipulated by the UGC for the post of assistant professor). Proficiency in ICT-enabled teaching, such as e-content on UGC INFONET, EMMRC or CEC websites, MOOC programmes on SWAYAM, LMS/CMS participation, or virtual and remote laboratory development. Research Aptitude: research publications with impact factor above 5.00, above 2.00, and below 2.00 in Clarivate's Web of Science / Scopus indexed / UGC CARE-listed journals (details to be appended). Papers in proceedings (with ISSN No.) of international or national seminars and conferences funded by UGC/CSIR/DRDO/DBT/DST/ICAR/ICSSR and similar bodies. International patents, post-doctoral fellowships, books and chapters in edited books, invited keynote addresses or plenary talks in the relevant area. Prior experience in conducting online programmes with sound technical knowledge in production and post-production of e-contents and video classes.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There is one post: Course Mentor (Online BBA Honours) - on Contract, 1 vacancy, reserved as OC (Open Competition). Qualification: Postgraduate degree in the relevant subject area (minimum 55% marks), NET / Ph.D. (Subject to U.G.C. ODL/OL Regulation 2020). Age limit: 50 Years as on 01.01.2026 (Relaxation permitted to eligible category). The notice does not list the category-wise relaxation. Pay: Consolidated pay of ₹40,000 /- per month. Tenure: One year and likely to be extended for another 2 years based on the annual appraisal report. The engagement is purely on contract basis. Degrees from outside Kerala: a degree obtained from universities or institutions outside the State of Keralam must be accompanied by the equivalency / eligibility certificate obtained from Mahatma Gandhi University. Reservation documents: candidates under the community reservation quota must submit the Community Certificate and Non-Creamy Layer Certificate issued by the authorities concerned. For the subject-specific eligibility of the post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The duly filled proforma attached with the notification Scanned copies of original documents proving age and community reservation (Community Certificate and Non-Creamy Layer Certificate, where applicable) Qualification proof: mark lists and degree certificates, and proof of specialisation Proof that the journals are approved by U.G.C. / peer reviewed, and the impact factor of the published articles Experience certificate and awards Proof for CGPA to percentage conversion Proof of all other additional qualifications Equivalency / eligibility certificate, for degrees from outside the State of Keralam

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection has two stages: initial screening of applications, then an interview. Screening: applications are screened first, and eligible candidates will be called for an interview. Interview: the interview format and date will be announced later. Admission to the interview is purely provisional and subject to verification of the candidates' original academic documents. Rank list: candidates considered for inclusion in the rank list must submit the original and attested copies of their educational records to the University later, as instructed. Agreement: the selected candidates shall execute an agreement with the University as per the existing norms.
